name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
benefit: Amount of AssistanceCrop Loss PercentageRs. 20,000/- per HectareCrop Loss of 33% to 60%Rs. 25,000/- per HectareCrop Loss of Over 60%
eligibility_rules: The applicant must be a farmer residing in Gujarat state. The applicant must have availed of a loan for agricultural purposes from a cooperative institution or a bank. The applicant must have suffered crop loss due to natural calamities such as drought, flood, or earthquake. The applicant must possess the land for agricultural purposes in his/her name or have the right to cultivate such land. The land should be surveyed by the Revenue Department of Gujarat and should have a record of rights. The crop loss should be certified by the Revenue Department of Gujarat. The applicant should have insured the crop under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana or any other crop insurance scheme recognized by the Government of Gujarat.
documents_required: required documentsProof of land ownership. Crop loss certificate issued by a government authority. Bank loan documents related to
farming activities. Aadhaar card or other government
issued identification. Passbook of the bank account where the financial assistance
will be disbursed. Any other documents as specified in the application form.
how_to_apply: Mode: Online & Offline Application ProcessVisit the official website of the Gujarat government's agriculture department. Navigate to the Mukhya Mantri Kisan Sahay Yojana page. Download the application form for the scheme. Fill in the application form with accurate details. Attach the required documents such as proof of land ownership, crop loss certificate, and bank loan documents. Submit the application form along with the supporting documents to the nearest agricultural office or bank branch.
